/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/0.source_en: Comfortable walking shoes with grip — Gamcheon's hillside alleys and Yonggungsa's 108 stairs both need traction.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/1.source_en: Light layer for the air-conditioned coach and the sea breeze at Yonggungsa and Songdo.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/2.source_en: Camera or smartphone (Gamcheon, Yongdusan twilight, and Songdo are the photo highlights).

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/3.source_en: Cash and card — most stops accept cards but Jagalchi and ⟦G0⟧ vendors prefer cash; ATM available at ⟦G1⟧ and Yongdusan.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/4.source_en: Cruise ship boarding pass (some terminals require it for re-entry).

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/1.source_en: Light rain: tour runs as scheduled — Yonggungsa under rain has its own atmosphere, and Gamcheon's alleys remain navigable with care.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/2.source_en: Heavy rain or storms: the guide may shorten outdoor time at Songdo and extend indoor stops; Yonggungsa's lower temple area and Gamcheon's stairs can become slippery.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/3.source_en: Typhoon-level weather or port closure: full refund or cruise-line rebooking arranged.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/1.source_en: Chinese-speaking guide available on request — book 3+ days ahead.
/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/1.tm: Chinesischsprachige Reiseleitung auf Anfrage — mindestens 3 Tage im Voraus buchen.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/2.source_en: Korean spoken throughout the day for menus, signage, and stall interactions; the guide handles translation.
/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/2.tm: Vor Ort wird den ganzen Tag Koreanisch gesprochen — auf Speisekarten, Schildern und an den Ständen; die Reiseleitung übersetzt.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/3.source_en: Multi-language printed itinerary card distributed at pickup.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/1.source_en: Yonggungsa has 108 stone steps down to the temple (skippable — upper viewing platforms exist).
/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/1.tm: Zum Yonggungsa führen 108 Steinstufen hinab (kann ausgelassen werden — oben gibt es Aussichtsplattformen).

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/2.source_en: Gamcheon is a hillside village with steep alleys and stairs throughout the photo route — traction shoes essential.
/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/2.tm: Gamcheon ist ein Hangdorf mit steilen Gassen und Treppen auf der ganzen Fotoroute — griffige Schuhe sind unerlässlich.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/3.source_en: Yongdusan ascent is covered by escalator from Gwangbok-ro; descent is by stairs.
/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/3.tm: Den Yongdusan erreicht man mit einer Rolltreppe von der Gwangbok-ro; der Abstieg erfolgt über Treppen.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/4.source_en: Jagalchi, ⟦G2⟧, ⟦G0⟧, and ⟦G1⟧ are flat and walkable.
/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/4.tm: Jagalchi, ⟦G2⟧, ⟦G0⟧ und ⟦G1⟧ sind eben und gut zu Fuß zu erkunden.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/5.source_en: Total walking ≈5–6 km plus stairs across the full day.
/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/5.tm: Insgesamt ≈5–6 km zu Fuß plus Treppen über den ganzen Tag.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/0.source_en: Return is guaranteed by 17:00 for ships with a 17:00+ sail-away — typical buffer 30–60 minutes for reboarding.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/1.source_en: For ships with an earlier 18:00–19:00 sail-away, notify at booking — the route will be shortened by abbreviating Songdo and Yongdusan to fit.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/2.source_en: The guide carries the cruise-line contact for each ship and will radio ahead in case of unexpected traffic delays.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/3.source_en: AtoC Korea has not missed a sail-away on this route in 4 seasons of operation.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/preview.source_en: Return is guaranteed by 17:00 for ships with a 17:00+ sail-away…

/practicalAccordionItems/7/content/1.source_en: Inside 24 hours: 50% refund (the coach and guide have been allocated for your day).

/practicalAccordionItems/7/content/2.source_en: No-show or missed pickup: no refund — but contact AtoC Korea operations immediately if cruise disembarkation is delayed and we will hold the coach for up to 30 min.

/practicalAccordionItems/7/content/3.source_en: Cruise itinerary change (port skipped): full refund regardless of timing.

/practicalAccordionItems/8/title.source_en: Surcharges, cancellation and who this tour is for
/practicalAccordionItems/8/title.tm: Zuschläge, Stornierung und für wen diese Tour gedacht ist

/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/0.source_en: Out-of-hours surcharge: if your ship requires a pickup before 08:00, or the tour finishes after 20:00, a surcharge of ₩10,000 per person applies and is paid on the day.
/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/0.tm: Zuschlag außerhalb der Regelzeiten: Erfordert Ihr Schiff eine Abholung vor 08:00 Uhr oder endet die Tour nach 20:00 Uhr, fällt ein Zuschlag von ₩10.000 pro Person an, zahlbar am Tag selbst.

/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/1.source_en: Cancellation: free up to 24 hours before the tour starts. Inside 24 hours the booking is non-refundable.
/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/1.tm: Stornierung: kostenlos bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Innerhalb von 24 Stunden ist die Buchung nicht erstattungsfähig.

/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/2.source_en: Minimum age: guests must be 4 years or older.
/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/2.tm: Mindestalter: Gäste müssen 4 Jahre oder älter sein.

/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/3.source_en: Cruise passengers only: this tour is sold to guests arriving on a cruise ship calling at Busan. Bookings from travellers without a Busan port call are declined and refunded.
/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/3.tm: Nur für Kreuzfahrtgäste: Diese Tour wird an Gäste verkauft, die mit einem in Busan anlegenden Kreuzfahrtschiff ankommen. Buchungen von Reisenden ohne Hafenaufenthalt in Busan werden abgelehnt und erstattet.

/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/4.source_en: Return timing: the day is built around your ship's all-aboard time, and the drop-off is scheduled ahead of it.
/practicalAccordionItems/8/content/4.tm: Rückkehrzeit: Der Tag ist um die All-aboard-Zeit Ihres Schiffes herum gebaut, und der Ausstieg ist davor eingeplant.

/practicalAccordionItems/8/preview.source_en: Pickup before 08:00 or finish after 20:00 adds ₩10,000 per person. Free cancellation up to 24 hours ahead. Age 4 and up. Cruise passengers only.
/practicalAccordionItems/8/preview.tm: Abholung vor 08:00 Uhr oder Ende nach 20:00 Uhr kosten ₩10.000 pro Person zusätzlich. Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vorher. Ab 4 Jahren. Nur für Kreuzfahrtgäste.
